parts.text:
Run the inbox digest for this test inbox. The tool state already has a gmail_token. Use the following mock emails (inject as state['mock_emails'] = [...]):
[
  {"id":"msg001","subject":"[URGENT] Server outage - need your response NOW","from":"ops@yourcompany.com","date":"Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:05:00 UTC","snippet":"Production is down, everyone is waiting on your config change. Please respond ASAP.","body_preview":"Hey Vivek, production is down and we are all blocked. The config change is waiting on your sign-off. Please respond ASAP — every minute costs $500.","labels":["INBOX","UNREAD"]},
  {"id":"msg002","subject":"50% off your next purchase - today only!","from":"deals@shopify-merchant.com","date":"Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:00:00 UTC","snippet":"Flash sale ends midnight! Don't miss out.","body_preview":"Your exclusive flash sale is live. Shop now for 50% off everything.","labels":["INBOX","UNREAD","CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS"]},
  {"id":"msg003","subject":"You have a new connection on LinkedIn","from":"notifications@linkedin.com","date":"Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:30:00 UTC","snippet":"John Smith accepted your connection request.","body_preview":"John Smith accepted your connection request on LinkedIn.","labels":["INBOX","UNREAD","CATEGORY_SOCIAL"]},
  {"id":"msg004","subject":"Invoice #2026-089 due in 3 days","from":"billing@cloudprovider.io","date":"Wed, 30 Sep 2026 07:00:00 UTC","snippet":"Your invoice for $1,240.00 is due on October 3rd.","body_preview":"Invoice #2026-089 for $1,240.00 is due on October 3rd, 2026. Please pay to avoid service interruption.","labels":["INBOX","UNREAD"]}
]

metadata.scenario_description: Inbox with: 1 urgent P1 (server outage requiring immediate action), 1 promotional email, 1 social notification, 1 financial P2 (invoice due in 3 days). The agent should filter out promo and social, include msg001 as P1 and msg004 as P2.
metadata.expected_behavior: Send digest with msg001 as P1 (action_needed, urgent), msg004 as P2 (financial_legal, important). msg002 and msg003 excluded. send=true, p1_count=1, p2_count=1.

metadata.scenario_description: Inbox with: newsletter (promo), Instagram social notification, GitHub star notification (bulk sender domain). All should be filtered. No P1/P2 should exist.
metadata.expected_behavior: No digest sent. status=skipped, reason=no_important_emails or inbox_empty, sent=false.

metadata.scenario_description: Inbox with: today's meeting invite (P1, scheduling, needs confirm), design review request with Friday deadline (P2, action_needed), team lunch reminder (P3 or P2 informational).
metadata.expected_behavior: Send digest. msg020=P1 (scheduling_calendar, action: Confirm attendance), msg021=P2 (action_needed, action: Review designs before Friday). msg022 may be P2 or P3. sent=true, p1_count>=1.

metadata.scenario_description: Inbox with: Netflix payment warning (financial P2 — real but not urgent in 24h), personal invite from friend (personal P2), contract renewal needing signature by Oct 5 (financial_legal P1 or P2).
metadata.expected_behavior: Send digest. msg030=P2 (financial_legal, action: Update Netflix payment). msg031=P2 (personal, action: Reply by Thursday). msg032=P1 or P2 (financial_legal, action: Sign contract by Oct 5). All three included. sent=true.

parts.text: Run the inbox digest. The inbox is empty — fetch_unread_emails returns {"status": "success", "emails": [], "total_fetched": 0, "total_after_filter": 0}.

metadata.scenario_description: Completely empty inbox. No unread messages. Agent must not send anything.
metadata.expected_behavior: No digest sent. status=skipped, reason=inbox_empty or no_important_emails, sent=false.

metadata.scenario_description: Mix of: Amazon shipment (bulk sender — should be filtered), Hacker News newsletter (should be filtered), and a manager's meeting request for today (P1). Only the meeting request should pass.
metadata.expected_behavior: msg040 and msg041 filtered out (bulk senders / newsletter). msg042=P1 (scheduling_calendar, action: Confirm 3pm call). sent=true, p1_count=1, p2_count=0.
